title: [GMCP 203.031.02] Production path: Tool poisoning, prompt injection, rug-pull, and exfiltration defenses
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-031-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: All server descriptions, schemas, prompts, resources, UI and tool output are untrusted data. GMCP detects and contains hidden instructions, cross-server shadowing, schema/description rug pulls, Unicode deception, poisoned resources, indirect prompt injection and staged exfiltration; material metadata changes invalidate consent and trust; and a maintained adversarial corpus proves no content can authorize tools, reveal secrets or widen policy. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
